name: Bandwa Pikemen

abilities.name: Barbarian Testudo
abilities.text: The troops of this unit raise their shields above their heads in a static defensive formation.

abilities.name: Pike Wall
abilities.text: The unit moves into a deep, close defensive formation.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: The unit moves into a close formation and raises shields.

abilities.name: Steady
abilities.text: Improves the unit's ability to defend at the cost of their mobility.

attributes.name: Expert Charge Defence
attributes.text: This unit’s melee attack and damage are increased against charging enemies.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

short: Pikemen; Bandwa - the original meaning of this word means «banner, flag», but it also applies to the military units having this banner, the number of which is similar to the late medieval Chorągiew (banner).
history: Originally migrating from the Baltic coast, the Goths settled in the Black Sea area but fragmented once their population outgrew the capacity of the region's natural resources. Following the departure of the Tervingi to the west, the Greuthungi continued to live in the area until pressure from Hunnic incursions, around AD370, caused a large part of the remaining population to migrate south into the Balkans and, crucially, Roman territory. Those left behind eventually became clients of the Huns, alternately rebelling and fighting for them in the west, notably at Chalons in AD451. Following the collapse of the Hunnic powerbase mid-way through the 5th century AD, with the Roman Empire in the west soon to follow, the surviving Greuthungi moved down into the Balkans, becoming known as the 'Ostrogoths' - literally 'Goths of the Rising Sun' or 'Eastern Goths'.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
